name: Caspofungin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero
summary: Caspofungin is cleared by slow chemical degradation and hepatic uptake; only about 1.4% is excreted unchanged in urine. The US label needs no dose change in kidney impairment and no supplement after hemodialysis, which does not remove it. Moderate liver impairment and CYP inducers such as rifampin change the dose.
kidney_function_basis: Label PK uses CrCl (mL/min); no dose bands.

bands.recommendation: No dose change (label). AUC rises 30% to 49% in moderate to end-stage kidney impairment after a single dose, without a dose change being needed (label).

crrt: Not in label. Li 2020 (Table 3): no change in CVVH, CVVHD or CVVHDF.
monitoring: Liver tests; potassium (low potassium is common); tacrolimus levels; liver enzymes with cyclosporine (label).

pediatric.usual_dose: 70 mg/m2 loading dose on day 1, then 50 mg/m2 once daily (label).
